visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of six glossy cinnamon rolls arranged in a white box, topped with crushed nuts and glistening with thick caramel syrup. A hand picks up one roll, rotating it to show the multiple layers of swirled dough and the rich, dark brown glaze. (2) The scene cuts to a street-level view of a small shop entrance featuring a white-framed door and red accents. Potted tropical plants and a red traffic cone are in the foreground, while a red awning hangs on the right side under an air conditioning unit. (3) Inside, a female staff member wearing a black mask, blue headscarf, and patterned apron is standing behind a wooden counter. She is stacking bright red rectangular boxes, with a shelf of paper bags and a kitchen area visible in the background. (4) Close-up shots follow, showing a hand using metal tongs to carefully place a fresh cinnamon roll onto a cooling rack. Other shots show a red box being closed and then opened to reveal a variety of flavored rolls, including those topped with sliced apples, orange peel, and raisins. (5) Detailed macro shots highlight the texture of a specific "sticky" cinnamon roll being pulled apart, revealing the soft, doughy interior and the stretchy caramel. The lighting is bright and warm, emphasizing the food's freshness and gooey consistency. (6) The camera pans across a chalkboard menu titled "WELCOME! CINNAMON ROLLS" which lists various flavors and prices in traditional Chinese. A customer is seen standing at the counter before the video ends with a close-up of the shop's logo, featuring a line-art drawing of a man and woman.
